Parish life

Fellowship & Care

Our life together does not end when the Divine Liturgy concludes. Coffee hour, shared meals, feast-day celebrations and caring for one another in times of need are the simple ways acquaintances become friends and a parish becomes a family. Whether you would like to host a Sunday coffee hour, bring a dish to a parish meal, take dinner to a family who needs one, or ask for a little help yourself, the next step is here.
